biotools.summary: Simplicity is a web-based interface for visualizing and analyzing high-throughput cancer cell line screens, allowing researchers to recalculate summary statistics at user-defined drug concentrations. It enables easier access and manipulation of screening data for researchers without extensive bioinformatics skills.
